biotools.summary: Open-source web application for building and running genomic data analysis workflows in the browser. Bioinformatics tools such as samtools, minimap2, bcftools, bedtools, seqtk, fastp and GTO are compiled to WebAssembly and run on the user's own computer, so data is not uploaded. Tools are published as signed bundles in the BioChef Registry and verified in the browser before they run. Workflows are built with drag and drop and shared as a single JSON file.
